items.headline: Tourism brings $1.35 billion to Quad Cities economy despite decline in visits
items.summary: The latest figures from Visit Quad Cities show that in FY 2026, 5.7 million visitors came to the region, resulting in $53 million in direct economic impact.

items.headline: Davenport holding special election for 2nd Ward council seat

items.headline: Illinois families save $11.4 million during back-to-school sales tax holiday
